title: Capability
description: A named, falsifiable function that one or more systems can perform. Capabilities are the vocabulary of the portfolio compiler. A capability is only considered proven when at least one VERIFIED evidence object references it. Duplicated capabilities across lineages are a consolidation signal.

capability_id.description: Stable slug. e.g. stale-worker-fencing, multi-tenant-auth, vector-similarity-search

name.description: Short human-readable label. Used in resume/portfolio projection.

description.description: One paragraph. What does this capability let the system do and why does it matter?

proven.description: Computed field. true only when evidence_ids contains at least one VERIFIED evidence object. Do not set manually.

evidence_ids.description: claim_ids from evidence.schema.json that support this capability

system_ids.description: system_ids from system.schema.json that expose this capability

resume_label.description: The exact phrase the portfolio compiler should emit when projecting this capability onto a resume. e.g. 'Designed generation-fenced lease protocol for distributed job scheduler'

resume_eligible.description: Only true when proven=true AND resume_label is set. The compiler enforces this gate.

duplicated_in_lineages.description: lineage_ids where an equivalent capability exists. Populated by the estate engine as a consolidation signal.

maturity.description: Derived from the highest-status evidence object referencing this capability.
